hints.tr: Kelime kısmına isteğe bağlı bir kesme işaretli devam ekle: `(?:'\w+)?`.
hints.en: Add an optional apostrophe part to the word: `(?:'\w+)?`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import re


def tokenize(text):
    return re.findall(r"\w+(?:'\w+)?|[^\w\s]", text)

print("|".join(tokenize("I can't believe it's here!")))
print("|".join(tokenize("Don't stop.")))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import re


def tokenize(text):
    return re.findall(r"\w+(?:'\w+)?|[^\w\s]", text)

print("|".join(tokenize("I can't believe it's here!")))
print("|".join(tokenize("Don't stop.")))
```
